name: PublicationRequired
summary: The card component of Publication Required (DUO_0000019). The requester's institution agreed to terms with the Publication obligation, scoped to the owner's dataset and the requester's project. Decides about the requester.

datasetID.description: DID of the governed dataset. Only ScopedAgreementCredentials whose agreementInfo.scope.dataset equals it are kept.
